visual_action: A video presents a "Say the word on the beat challenge" in a game-like format. Across five rounds, a grid of eight images appears, and a green highlight box rapidly moves over them in time with the music. The images include photos of Donald Trump (wearing a cowboy hat and holding a flag), photos of Joe Biden (looking down), red "MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN" hats, gold bars, a fire emoji, and other abstract images. The video concludes with a black and white logo for "THE WHITE HOUSE".
